data.action: 把落花夹进笔记本，轻合书页后看向花枝。
data.description: 午后的花房里，玛夏穿鼠尾草绿长裙和奶油色短开衫，把一朵掉落的小花夹进随身笔记本。她坐在藤椅上轻轻合拢书页，抬头确认枝上的花仍好好开着，眼中带着温柔满足。
data.promptProse: Maria sits on a wicker chair in the greenhouse, pressing a small fallen flower between her notebook pages. Her sage-green long dress and cream cropped cardigan remain in medium view as she closes the book and looks up to check the blossoms still on their branch. Leaves overlap the glass panels behind. Filtered daylight catches the flower and her sleeves, casting fine wicker shadows beneath the seat.
data.title: 玛夏 · 花房里的压花书页
